properties.Name: Wylie Avenue (Hill District stretch)
properties.Description: A short stretch of Wylie Avenue, the Hill District's main street, between Devilliers Street and Elmore Street. The Lower Hill section, which ran down to Downtown, is not shown here. Add it from your Sanborn sheets.
properties.Source: Historical Marker Database (Ebenezer Baptist Church marker at Wylie Avenue and Devilliers Street; Crawford Grill marker at Wylie Avenue and Elmore Street)
properties.Certainty: Drawn as a straight line between marker locations on the street, so it is accurate to within tens of metres.

properties.Name: Bedford Avenue (Hill District stretch)
properties.Description: Bedford Avenue in the Hill District, drawn through the marker locations at 1727 Bedford Avenue, 2217 Bedford Avenue, and Bedford Avenue at Junilla Street (Greenlee Field).
properties.Source: Wikipedia, List of Pennsylvania state historical markers in Allegheny County (Pennsylvania Historical and Museum Commission)
properties.Certainty: Drawn as a straight line between marker locations on the street, so it is accurate to within tens of metres.
